Problem Statement:
Write a C program that reads a list of strings from the user and then performs the following operations using pointer-to-pointer (char **):
1. Reverse each string.
2. Swap the first and last string in the list.
3. Print the modified list.
input_spec:
The first line contains an integer n, the number of strings.
The next n lines each contain a single string.
output_spec: Print the modified list of strings, one per line.
